title: Real Snakebite First-Aid Rules Poster
title_te: పాము కాటుకు సరైన ప్రథమ చికిత్స పోస్టర్
problem: When a snake bit a neighbor in our village, people panicked, tied tight cords, and wasted time on bad ideas instead of taking him to the hospital.
idea: A bold step-by-step snakebite poster for our village centre. Gemini gives the correct hospital emergency steps and Canva makes the poster. Here you can read the steps and test yourself.

items.title: Stay calm
items.text: Keep the person calm and lying still. Moving fast spreads the poison faster.

items.title: Call 108
items.text: Call 108 ambulance at once, or take the person quickly to the nearest government hospital.
items.te: వెంటనే 108కి ఫోన్ చేయండి లేదా దగ్గరి ప్రభుత్వ ఆసుపత్రికి తీసుకెళ్ళండి.

items.title: Keep the limb still
items.text: Keep the bitten arm or leg still and below heart level, like a broken bone.

items.title: Remove tight things
items.text: Take off rings, bangles, anklets and tight clothes near the bite.

items.title: Get anti-venom
items.text: Only hospital anti-venom treats snakebite. Don't waste time anywhere else.
items.te: ఆసుపత్రిలో ఇచ్చే విరుగుడు మందు మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది.

questions.q: Should we tie a tight cord above the bite?
options: No, tight cords can harm the limb
questions.why: Tight cords stop blood flow and can badly damage the arm or leg.

questions.q: Should we cut the bite and suck out the poison?
questions.why: Cutting and sucking do not help and cause infection and bleeding.

questions.q: Where should we take the person?
questions.why: Only anti-venom at a hospital treats snakebite. Every minute counts.

questions.q: What should the person do while waiting?
We don't know if the snake was poisonous. What do we do?
questions.why: Always go to the hospital. Doctors will check and decide.

how: Ask Gemini for the correct snakebite first-aid steps followed by hospitals.
Check the steps with our PHC doctor, nurse or science teacher.
Open Canva and choose a big A3 poster template.
Make two columns: green 'DO' and red 'DON'T', with pictures for each step.
Add '108' in very big numbers and the name of the nearest hospital.
Print the poster and stick it at the village centre and Panchayat office.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Give me the correct, hospital-approved first-aid steps for snakebite in simple English and Telugu, as a DO and DON'T list for a village poster. Include calling 108 and going to a hospital for anti-venom.
